cases.sentence: Давид перешел на другую сторону и встал на вершине горы вдали, между ними было ___.
cases.explain: «большое расстояние» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: Then David went over to the other side, and stood on the top of the mountain afar off; a great space being between them;

cases.sentence: Они прогнали меня от моей доли в ___ и сказали: «Ступай, служи другим богам!»
cases.explain: «Господнем наследии» — after the preposition «в», for location or topic.
cases.translation: Now therefore, please let my lord the king hear the words of his servant. If it is so that Yahweh has stirred you up against me, let him accept an offering. But if it is the children of men, they are cursed before Yahweh; for they have driven me out today that I shouldn’t cling to Yahweh’s inheritance, saying, ‘Go, serve other gods!’

cases.sentence: Они прогнали меня от моей доли в Господнем наследии и сказали: «Ступай, служи ___!»
cases.explain: «другим богам» — the dative marks the indirect object or recipient.
cases.translation: Now therefore, please let my lord the king hear the words of his servant. If it is so that Yahweh has stirred you up against me, let him accept an offering. But if it is the children of men, they are cursed before Yahweh; for they have driven me out today that I shouldn’t cling to Yahweh’s inheritance, saying, ‘Go, serve other gods!’

cases.sentence: − Вот копье царя, − ответил Давид. − Пусть кто-нибудь из твоих ___ перейдет сюда и возьмет его.
cases.explain: «молодых слуг» — after the preposition «из», the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: David answered, “Behold the spear, O king! Then let one of the young men come over and get it.
